testimonials.quote: We think we had the best wedding cake ever!! Your Legos looked like real Legos!!! The Lego people were so us!!! And the taste of the cake and buttercream, best ever!! We received so many compliments on our cake. You helped make our day perfect, thank you so much!

testimonials.author: Margerita Moore
testimonials.quote: Marwa Crazy Cakes came thru again. I have had several cakes and items and was never disappointed.

testimonials.quote: Seema made a cake that looked exactly like my house because our house is 100 years old this year. What a marvelous cake! Everyone was blown away, and the cake was so delicious as well. Just stunning!

content.about.communityP1: Marwa Crazy Cakes is proudly local and licensed, serving Chagrin Falls and the greater Cleveland community with artistry backed by professionalism. Each creation is made with the highest standards of safety, quality, and care.
content.about.communityTitle: Rooted in Community, Licensed for Trust
content.about.experienceP1: At Marwa Crazy Cakes, the journey is as meaningful as the cake itself. For our couples, the wedding cake tasting is a cherished part of the process—a moment to pause, dream, and savor. Guests are welcomed into a warm, personalized consultation where they sample flavors, discuss inspirations, and explore designs that reflect their unique story.
content.about.experienceP2: Seema listens with care, sketches ideas, and transforms visions into edible art. The process is intimate, refined, and memorable—ensuring that by the time your wedding day arrives, the cake feels like it was created exclusively for you.
content.about.experienceTitle: An Experience, Not Just a Cake

content.about.headline: Seema Acharya — The Artist Behind the Magic
content.about.imageAlt: Seema Acharya, cake designer and sugar artist, founder of Marwa Crazy Cakes
content.about.intro: Every cake begins with a story. For Seema Acharya, renowned cake artist and founder of Marwa Crazy Cakes in Chagrin Falls, OH, that story is one of artistry, imagination, and devotion to craft. Her work—spanning sculpted showpieces, towering wedding cakes, and avant-garde sugar art—has earned her recognition on Netflix's Sugar Rush, Food Network competitions, and in the pages of Cake Masters Magazine.
content.about.introItalic: Seema is not just a cake designer—she is a storyteller. Her sugar creations are celebrated for their sculptural elegance, meticulous detail, and the ability to capture the essence of every occasion.
content.about.quote: Marwa Crazy Cakes isn't just about cake. It's about wonder, memory, and art that you can taste.
